headline: 🔥 'SENIOR ADMINISTRATION OFFICIAL' QUOTED ON FRONT PAGE — IDENTITY UNKNOWN
factoid: Anonymous-source reporting was central to the 2003 Iraq war narrative. NYT reporter Judith Miller's pre-war WMD articles relied heavily on Iraqi National Congress sources later determined to be unreliable; the Times issued an editor's note in 2004 acknowledging the coverage's failures.

headline: 🔥 VIRAL CHAIN EMAIL HITS YOUR MOM — FWD: FWD: FWD: TRUTH ABOUT…
factoid: Anti-Obama chain emails circulating from late 2006 onward — 'Who is Barack Obama?' the most-forwarded — were forwarded an estimated 11+ million times by 2008 according to internal traffic estimates from major email providers. The author has never been identified.

headline: 🔥 BECK'S CHALKBOARD MOMENT GOES VIRAL — 'WHO IS GEORGE SOROS?'
factoid: Beck's chalkboard segments diagramming political conspiracies regularly trended on social media in 2009-2011. The format directly inspired similar visual treatments in later QAnon decoder content and 2020 election-fraud advocacy materials.

headline: 🔥 SWIFT BOAT 'VETERAN' BOOKED ON ALL THREE NETWORKS — CANDIDATE STAFF IN PANIC
factoid: Swift Boat Veterans for Truth members were booked on all three U.S. broadcast networks during August-September 2004. Cable bookings totaled 70+ appearances in the same window. The Kerry campaign's internal post-mortem judged the attack the single most-damaging surface in the entire race.

headline: 🔥 RED-LETTER DRUDGE HEADLINE AT 4 AM — CABLE NEWS LEADS WITH IT BY 7
factoid: A red-letter headline at the top of drudgereport.com could redirect that morning's cable news agenda. A 2007 Politico analysis tracked ~67% of Drudge's lead links migrating to cable news within 24 hours; the practice was a documented industry pattern through ~2012.

headline: ⚡ FRENZY: COLOR-CODED TERROR ALERT RAISED MID-NEWS CYCLE — EVERY NETWORK GOES WALL-TO-WALL
factoid: The Department of Homeland Security's color-coded terror alert system (March 2002 – April 2011) was raised six times to Orange. A 2011 review found no documented case where the elevations corresponded to specific actionable intelligence. The system was discontinued.
